answer: One 60-credit opal bond per identity blocks fakes: each must do verified work with 12 distinct counterparties to pass the velvet rope; same-cluster trades don't count. Each epoch a tide audit sweeps the public graph and burns tide-pool rings trading only with themselves. K-th fake pays 540 plus 25(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 13,027,500 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 480 once, gets its bond back after three clean epochs, keeps its full share.
